authors: J.G. Koerner, D. Kreimer, K. Schilcher (and D. Kreimer 1990)
title: A practicable gamma5-scheme in dimensional regularization (KKS); The gamma5-problem and anomalies - a Clifford algebra approach (Kreimer 1990)
journal: Z. Phys. C54 (1992) 503-512 (KKS); Phys. Lett. B237 (1990) 59 (Kreimer)
claim: Keep an anticommuting gamma5 in D dimensions and give up cyclicity of the trace: gamma5-odd traces are evaluated with a non-cyclic linear functional ('Trace') that agrees with the 4d trace at D=4; the result then depends on where the trace is started (the 'reading point'), and the ABJ anomaly appears as the non-cyclic output of the scheme. KKS turn this into a practical prescription and show (per Kreimer 1994) that starting the reading at different points in graphs contributing to the same process can violate gauge invariance in the SM.
loop_order: one-loop anomaly and low-order applications (details not seen)
scheme: DREG with anticommuting gamma5, non-cyclic trace functional, reading-point prescription; epsilon tensor projected on the 4d index set
symmetry_argument: Ward identities of vector vertices kept by anticommutation; the anomaly localized at the reading point (axial vertex)

assumed: a consistent rule for choosing reading points in every graph and its counterterm graphs (formalized only in Kreimer 1994, S5.02)
checked_partially: one-loop anomaly reproduced; equivalence of reading points of types i_+ and i_I found in the 1-loop anomaly analysis (as reported in S5.02)

evidence: Kreimer hep-ph/9401354 refs. [4], [6] and Sec. 2: AAA = (1/3) AVV obtained by Bose-symmetrizing over reading points; gauge-invariance violation in the SM if reading starts at different points in graphs of the same process (citing [6] = KKS)
red_flags: not on arXiv; content known only through Kreimer hep-ph/9401354 and later citations

the prescription is incomplete without a rule for multi-loop graphs with subdivergences, several gamma5-odd loops, or anomalous subgraphs; later works (S5.07_Chen2023, S5.11, S5.12) show residual ambiguities at high loop order
cross_checks: formalized in S5.02_Kreimer1994; critique/alternatives in S5.03_Jegerlehner2001; modern variant in S5.07_Chen2023
source_access: secondary: cited in hep-ph/9401354 (full text read)
notes: Lead verified via INSPIRE: 'A practicable gamma(5) scheme in dimensional regularization', J.G. Koerner, D. Kreimer, K. Schilcher, Z. Phys. C54 (1992) 503-512 (Kreimer's ref. [6] lists the authors in a different order); Kreimer PLB 237 (1990) 59.
